source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch raises three IMAP compaction-refusal messages from Debug to Warning. CanCompactNow still returns false for pending pseudo/offline activity and a relevant offline-state query failure; StartNext queues that folder for retry. Unsupported offline operations remain a different case. This improves visibility of the reason without changing when compaction proceeds or proving that a later retry succeeds. No compaction ran.
title: Compaction refusal diagnostics preserve the retry decision
